title:
Epic to implement customized `FILTER_SUBMIT` action for `Reliability.ModelSetupAssetFilterPanel`.

This will create a filter for the non-project filter panel fields (denoted by starting with 'projectType').
Then it will add custom logic for those project filters.

Finally, the filter created is applied to the payload `gridId` with `filterPanelId` as the sourceMetadataId for the
filter applied. See {@link UiSdlDataRedux#mergeArgumentsAction}.
name: AssetGridFilterPanelSubmitEpic
